exposure: Knowledge about COVID-19 risk during pregnancy
Practices related to COVID-19 during pregnancy
outcome: Knowledge about COVID-19 risk during pregnancy
Practices related to COVID-19 during pregnancy
cohort: 376 pregnant women attending antenatal clinics in Karachi, Pakistan
finding: Pregnant women in Karachi, Pakistan had inadequate knowledge, negative attitudes, and poor practices regarding pregnancy during the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: More than half of the respondents thought that concealing symptoms and delivering at home would be better.
